versions.subject: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Clip.exe in Scripts
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    EventID: 4104
selection_2:
    - ScriptBlockText|re: '(?i).*?echo.*clip.*&&.*(Clipboard|i`?n`?v`?o`?k`?e`?).*'
selection_3:
    EventID: 4103
selection_4:
    - Payload|re: '(?i).*?echo.*clip.*&&.*(Clipboard|i`?n`?v`?o`?k`?e`?).*'
condition: ( selection_1 and selection_2 ) or ( selection_3 and selection_4 )
versions.spl: | rex field=ScriptBlockText "(?<ScriptBlockTextMatch>(?i).*?echo.*clip.*&&.*(Clipboard|i`?n`?v`?o`?k`?e`?).*)" | eval ScriptBlockTextCondition=if(isnotnull(ScriptBlockTextMatch), "true", "false") | rex field=Payload "(?<PayloadMatch>(?i).*?echo.*clip.*&&.*(Clipboard|i`?n`?v`?o`?k`?e`?).*)" | eval PayloadCondition=if(isnotnull(PayloadMatch), "true", "false") | search (EventID=4104 ScriptBlockTextCondition="true") OR (EventID=4103 PayloadCondition="true")
